actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Doric makes two Shaped Claw or Sling attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Shaped Claw
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Doric casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Animal Messenger|animal messenger]], [[Tools/Spells/Beast Sense|beast sense]], [[Tools/Spells/Speak With Animals|speak with animals]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Cure Wounds|cure wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Entangle|entangle]], [[Tools/Spells/Faerie Fire|faerie fire]], [[Tools/Spells/Thunderwave|thunderwave]]

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape (5/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: Doric magically transforms into a Beast with a challenge rating of 3 or less or into an owlbear (see the Monster Manual). Doric can remain in that form for up to 2 hours. She can choose whether her equipment falls to the ground, melds with her new form, or is worn by the new form. Doric reverts to her true form if she is incapacitated or dies. She can revert to her true form using a bonus action. While Doric is transformed, her stat block is replaced by the stat block of that form, except she keeps her current hit points, her hit point maximum, this bonus action, her alignment, and her Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores.

reactions.name: Fiery Rebuke (3/Day)
reactions.desc: When Doric is damaged by a creature that she can see within 60 feet of herself, she magically engulfs the creature in flames. The creature must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) fire damage on failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Edgin makes two Reinforced Lute or Shortsword attacks.

actions.name: Reinforced Lute
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) thunder damage.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) thunder damage.

actions.name: Disorienting Words
actions.desc: Edgin magically taunts up to three creatures he can see within 60 feet of himself. Each creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage and have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of Edgin's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Edgin casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Friends|friends]], [[Tools/Spells/Message|message]]
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Charm Person|charm person]], [[Tools/Spells/Disguise Self|disguise self]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Suggestion|suggestion]]

reactions.name: Inspiring Words (3/Day)
reactions.desc: When a creature Edgin can see within 60 feet of himself fails an ability check, an attack roll, or a saving throw, Edgin grants the creature magical encouragement. The creature can roll a d8 and add the number rolled to the total, potentially turning the failure into a success.

traits.name: Disarming Charm
traits.desc: While Forge isn't wearing armor, his AC includes his Charisma modifier.

traits.name: Double-Cross
traits.desc: If Forge hits a creature friendly to him with an attack roll, the attack is automatically a critical hit.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If Forge is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails, provided he isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Forge makes two Dagger attacks, two Heavy Crossbow attacks, or one of each.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 24 (7d6) poison damage, and the target is poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 24 (7d6) poison damage. Hit or Miss: If the target is a creature, it has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of Forge's next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning
bonus_actions.desc: Forge takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action, or he gives himself advantage on the next attack roll he makes before the end of this turn.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.desc: Forge halves the damage he takes from an attack that hits him. He must be able to see the attacker.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.desc: At the start of her turn, Holga can gain advantage on melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against her have advantage until the start of her next turn.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Holga carries a darksteel greataxe, a magic weapon that grants her resistance to lightning damage while she carries it (included above).

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.desc: While Holga isn't wearing armor, her AC includes her Constitution modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Holga makes three Darksteel Greataxe or Improvised Weapon attacks, in any combination.

actions.name: Darksteel Greataxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Improvised Weapon
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

bonus_actions.name: Wrestle
bonus_actions.desc: Holga shoves a creature within 5 feet of herself. That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be moved 5 feet into an unoccupied space of Holga's choice.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Simon has advantage on saving throws he makes to avoid or end the charmed condition on himself, and magic can't put him to sleep.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Simon carries a bag of holding, two pairs of sending stones, and a deathly token (see Spellcasting).

traits.name: Wild Magic
traits.desc: When Simon takes 20 or more damage from a single source or takes damage from a critical hit, he must roll on the Wild Magic Surge table in the Player's Handbook.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Simon makes three Quarterstaff or Chaos Bolt attacks. He can replace one attack with one use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands, plus 11 (2d10) force damage.

actions.name: Chaos Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) damage of a random type determined by rolling a d8: 1, acid; 2, cold; 3, fire; 4, force; 5, lightning; 6, poison; 7, psychic; 8, thunder.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Roll a d6. On a roll of 1, Simon must roll on the Wild Magic Surge table in the Player's Handbook. On a roll of 2 or higher, Simon casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|minor illusion]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]], [[Tools/Spells/Speak With Dead|speak with dead]] (Simon must be holding his deathly token to cast this spell)
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Fog Cloud|fog cloud]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]], [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|magic missile]], [[Tools/Spells/Spider Climb|spider climb]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Bigby'S Hand|Bigby's hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Major Image|major image]]

reactions.name: Sheltering Shield (3/Day)
reactions.desc: When Simon or another creature he can see within 10 feet of himself would take damage, he conjures a shimmering, 10-foot-radius sphere of magical force centered on himself. Creatures inside the sphere have resistance to the damage that triggered this reaction.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Sofina wears a magic robe that grants her a +2 bonus to AC and a +1 bonus to saving throws (included above).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Sofina makes three Necrotic Strike attacks.

actions.name: Necrotic Strike
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (5d10 + 5) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Swarm of Meteors (1/Day)
actions.desc: Sofina magically calls down a meteor swarm that detonates in four 40-foot-radius spheres, each one centered on a point she can see within 1 mile of herself. These spheres can overlap. Each creature in one or more of these spheres must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) fire damage and 35 (10d6) bludgeoning damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature in multiple spheres takes this damage only once.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Sofina casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Message|message]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Bestow Curse|bestow curse]], [[Tools/Spells/Bigby'S Hand|Bigby's hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Dimension Door|dimension door]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]], [[Tools/Spells/Otiluke'S Resilient Sphere|Otiluke's resilient sphere]], [[Tools/Spells/Thunderwave|thunderwave]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Evard'S Black Tentacles|Evard's black tentacles]], [[Tools/Spells/Finger Of Death|finger of death]], [[Tools/Spells/Time Stop|time stop]]

bonus_actions.name: Summon Wraith (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: Sofina magically summons the spirit of a Thayan assassin, which appears as a wraith (see the Monster Manual). The summoned wraith appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Sofina, whom it obeys. The summoned wraith takes its turn immediately after Sofina. It lasts for 1 hour, until it or Sofina dies, or until Sofina dismisses it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Aura of Protection
traits.desc: Xenk and his allies within 10 feet of him have advantage on saving throws.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Xenk makes three Daggersword attacks and uses Daggersword Flourish. He can replace Daggersword Flourish with Cleansing Touch if it's available.

actions.name: Daggersword
actions.desc: Choose the attack that corresponds to the daggersword's current form (see Daggersword Shift below):

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 6 (1d12) radiant damage.

actions.name: Shortsword and Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 6 (1d12) radiant damage.

actions.name: Daggersword Flourish
actions.desc: Choose the option that corresponds to the daggersword's current form (see Daggersword Shift below):

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Xenk magically detaches the longsword's blade from its hilt, launching the blade at a creature he can see within 30 feet of himself. The target must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target is impaled by the blade, taking 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage, and is knocked prone. At the end of the current turn, the blade magically reattaches to its hilt.

actions.name: Shortsword and Dagger
actions.desc: Xenk lashes out with both weapons. Each creature of his choice within 10 feet of him must make a DC 16 Dexterity throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of Xenk's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

actions.name: Cleansing Touch (1/Day)
actions.desc: Xenk touches a creature within 5 feet of himself. The target magically regains 27 (6d8) hit points and gains the benefit of a [[Tools/Spells/Lesser Restoration|lesser restoration]] spell.

bonus_actions.name: Daggersword Shift
bonus_actions.desc: Xenk changes the form of his daggersword, choosing one of the following forms: a longsword, or a shortsword in one hand and a dagger in the other.
